title: Bradford Council: Supporting the ASC front door with AI digital assistants
summary: Bradford reports that Annie handles about 50 conversations weekly, with 20% outside office hours and 74% user satisfaction.
account: Bradford reports that its Annie adult-social-care assistant answers questions on the web and WhatsApp, including outside contact-center hours and in several languages. Since October 2025, around 50 conversations weekly, 20% out of hours, and 74% user satisfaction are reported. Contact-center staff also use Annie to find resources. Equivalence to one full-time adviser is the council's claim, not a demonstrated staffing reduction. A planned 20% channel shift is a target.
purpose: Provide accessible adult-social-care information, advice, and signposting through a digital assistant.
system: Annie, Bradford’s AIDA adult-social-care digital assistant on the web and WhatsApp
developer: Bullet AI, with council co-production facilitated by CC2i
domain: Adult social care and public information

ratings.reason: A functioning multilingual, 24/7 advice channel handles roughly 50 conversations weekly. This is a reported service-capability gain.
Actual out-of-hours and multilingual use supports improved access to advice. The grade concerns access, not improved health or completed care provision.

ai_role.statement: Annie retrieves and combines information from trusted service resources, asks clarifying questions, and supports multilingual conversations. The reported access and usage gains are attributed to the assistant, while improved care outcomes are not established.

evidence.citation: Local Government Association, AI case-study bank. Council or project account published by LGA. Hosting and editorial curation do not establish independent outcome evaluation.
evidence.title: Bradford Council: Supporting the ASC front door with AI digital assistants

produced_by: Bradford co-produced the AIDA approach with Norfolk and West Northamptonshire councils, CC2i, and Bullet AI.
The Bradford assistant uses trusted service information and operates through web and WhatsApp channels.
must_hold: The source does not establish which conditions are necessary to reproduce the reported benefit.

headline: Bradford adds multilingual, out-of-hours social-care advice

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The deployer's report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
